response_summary: Created and verified the AEGIS threat model and Phase 1 delivery plan, documenting trust boundaries, twelve threat scenarios, current evidence limits, dependencies, acceptance criteria and privileged-release stop conditions.

Ported the reviewed SQLite security-store descriptor-leak fix to the assigned branch and added a regression proving a rejected hard-linked database descriptor is closed without altering the external target; opened scoped task issue #80.

Closed a policy enforcement gap: registry rate_limit declarations were structurally validated but not enforced by any durable limiter, so configured limits now fail closed with a stable denial; added positive/negative regression coverage and documented the limitation.
Closed the SQLite connection when SecurityStore construction fails after connect (including PRAGMA/schema setup), with deterministic injected-failure regression proving the connection is closed.

Completed a source-level audit-event lifecycle coverage matrix against the normative authorization lifecycle and both audit schema versions; documented missing or ambiguous presentation, dismissal, invalidation, revocation, consume and reconciliation event coverage without changing shared contracts.

Completed the field-level audit-event v0.1.0/v0.2.0 required, nullable and conditional field review; recorded schema-test source coverage and incorporated NEXUS-07 event ownership and reconciliation guidance without changing shared contracts.
